hook.en: The chance of rain today may be 30%. But if you already see dark clouds over Chamundi Hills, the chance is much higher. Probability that uses a known fact is conditional probability.
hook.kn: ಇಂದು ಮಳೆ ಬರುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ 30% ಇರಬಹುದು. ಆದರೆ ಚಾಮುಂಡಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮೋಡ ಕಂಡರೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು. ತಿಳಿದ ಸಂಗತಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುವ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆಯೇ ಷರತ್ತುಬದ್ಧ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ.

objectives.en: Use the properties of conditional probability

narration.en: The chance of rain today may be 30%. But if you already see dark clouds over Chamundi Hills, the chance is much higher. Probability that uses a known fact is conditional probability.
narration.kn: ಇಂದು ಮಳೆ ಬರುವ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ 30% ಇರಬಹುದು. ಆದರೆ ಚಾಮುಂಡಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮೋಡ ಕಂಡರೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು. ತಿಳಿದ ಸಂಗತಿಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುವ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆಯೇ ಷರತ್ತುಬದ್ಧ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ.

body.en: If $E$ and $F$ are events of the same sample space and $P(F) \ne 0$, the probability of $E$ given that $F$ has occurred is $P(E|F) = \frac{P(E\cap F)}{P(F)}$. In effect $F$ becomes the new sample space.
body.kn: P(F) ≠ 0 ಆದಾಗ, F ಸಂಭವಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿದಾಗ E ಯ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ P(E|F) = P(E ∩ F)/P(F). F ಹೊಸ ಮಾದರಿ ಆಕಾಶವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: P(E|F) is read "probability of E given F"
For equally likely outcomes: P(E|F) = n(E ∩ F)/n(F)

narration.en: The probability of E given F is the probability of E and F together, divided by the probability of F. Think of F as the new, smaller sample space.
narration.kn: P(F) ≠ 0 ಆದಾಗ, F ಸಂಭವಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿದಾಗ E ಯ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತೆ P(E|F) = P(E ∩ F)/P(F). F ಹೊಸ ಮಾದರಿ ಆಕಾಶವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: The teacher uses a Venn diagram to show that knowing F has happened makes F the new sample space, then works two examples.

say.en: The rectangle is the sample space S. Inside it are two events, E and F, which overlap.
Now we are told F has happened. F becomes our new sample space. Only the part of E inside F still counts.
So the conditional probability of E given F is the probability of E and F, divided by the probability of F.
Example: a die is thrown. F is "even", which is 2, 4, 6. E is "the number is 4". Inside F, only one of three outcomes is in E.
Another: P of A is 7 by 13, P of B is 9 by 13 and P of A and B is 4 by 13. Then P of A given B is 4 by 9, and P of B given A is 4 by 7.

body.en: $P(S|F) = P(F|F) = 1$. For events $A$, $B$: $P(A\cup B\,|\,F) = P(A|F) + P(B|F) - P(A\cap B\,|\,F)$. Also $P(E'|F) = 1 - P(E|F)$.
body.kn: P(S|F) = P(F|F) = 1. P(A ∪ B | F) = P(A|F) + P(B|F) − P(A ∩ B | F). P(E′|F) = 1 − P(E|F).

narration.en: Conditional probability behaves like ordinary probability inside F. The probability of F given F is one, the addition rule still works, and the complement rule gives one minus P of E given F.
narration.kn: P(S|F) = P(F|F) = 1. P(A ∪ B | F) = P(A|F) + P(B|F) − P(A ∩ B | F). P(E′|F) = 1 − P(E|F).

caption.en: Keep P(E ∩ F) fixed and change P(F). The curve shows P(E|F) = P(E ∩ F)/P(F); the readout is for your chosen P(F).

narration.en: Fix the overlap and shrink F. The smaller F is, the more the overlap counts, so the conditional probability rises.

tryThis.en: When F is the whole sample space (P(F) = 1), P(E|F) = P(E ∩ F).
Halve P(F): what happens to P(E|F)?
Check that P(E|F) + P(E′|F) is always 1.

problem.en: A die is thrown. E: "the number is 4", F: "the number is even". Find P(E|F).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A die is thrown. E: "the number is 4", F: "the number is even". Find P(E|F).

problem.en: Given P(A) = 7/13, P(B) = 9/13 and P(A ∩ B) = 4/13, find P(A|B) and P(B|A).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Given P(A) = 7/13, P(B) = 9/13 and P(A ∩ B) = 4/13, find P(A|B) and P(B|A).
Roll-call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ರೋಲ್ ಕಾಲ್ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ರೋಲ್ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

points.en: The given event F becomes the new sample space.
points.kn: ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಘಟನೆ F ಹೊಸ ಮಾದರಿ ಆಕಾಶವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: P(E′|F) = 1 − P(E|F), and in general P(E|F) ≠ P(F|E).

narration.en: Recap. P(E|F) = P(E ∩ F)/P(F), when P(F) ≠ 0. The given event F becomes the new sample space. P(E′|F) = 1 − P(E|F), and in general P(E|F) ≠ P(F|E).
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. P(F) ≠ 0 ಆದಾಗ P(E|F) = P(E ∩ F)/P(F). ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಘಟನೆ F ಹೊಸ ಮಾದರಿ ಆಕಾಶವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. P(E′|F) = 1 − P(E|F); ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ P(E|F) ≠ P(F|E).
